Population increased in Sandwell

The estimated population of Sandwell in 2024 was 353,860 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Sandwell's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Sandwell increased by 3.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Sandwell was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Sandwell

The average (median) age fell to 36.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Sandwell has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Sandwell is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Sandwell's population of 353,860 usual residents was made up of:

  • 78,758 people aged 0 to 15 years, (22.3%)
  • 223,861 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.3%)
  • 51,241 people aged 65 years and over, (14.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Sandwell has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (14.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Sandwell, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Sandwell
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Sandwell, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,451 people (0.4%). In total, there were 4,559 births and 3,108 deaths in Sandwell.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,450 (-1%). There were 19,655 people entering the area and 23,105 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Sandwell's population of 6,026 (1.7%) as a result of 8,156 people entering the area and 2,130 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Sandwell was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Sandwell in mid-2023 is 349,834.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,747 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 464 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,283 people.
